policies.title: No secrets are hardcoded
policies.statement: API keys, tokens, private keys, encryption keys and credentialed URLs are never written as literal values in a function, endpoint or other object's definition, or in an agent's settings. They are read from workspace environment variables ($env) instead, and the value is set by the owner, never in code. A value already held in an environment variable is compliant. This policy recognises built-in credential shapes only (including Twilio, Stripe, AWS, OpenAI and similar keys); it does not detect a plain password typed into code, so such a password must be reviewed separately.
